name: Refybe
author: refybe

sections.description:
• [refybe_game uid="CAMPAIGN-UID"] shows a game. Optional: mode (inline, popup, popup_btn, exit, exit_btn), button_text, height.
    Find the Campaign UID in Refybe: open your campaign, go to Settings and click Copy next to “Campaign UID” under Basic Information.
  • [refybe_loyalty] shows your participant loyalty page. Optional: company, height.
    Find the Company ID in Refybe: go to Company > Settings and click Copy next to “Company ID”.
  • The same two are available as blocks: “Refybe Game” and “Refybe Loyalty Page”.

Before the loyalty page works, add the domain of your website to the allowed domains under Loyalty > Embed in Refybe. Until you do, the loyalty page refuses to load in a frame. Only one game can be shown per page.

External services

This plugin connects to the Refybe service (https://refybe.com), which the site owner needs an account for. The Refybe URL can be changed under Settings > Refybe for white-label domains.

  • Games: the shortcode or block adds a script from https://refybe.com/api/embed.js to the page. The script shows the game in a frame from refybe.com. When the page URL contains utm_source, utm_medium or utm_campaign, those values are passed to the game to measure the visit per channel.
  • Loyalty page: the shortcode or block shows https://refybe.com/l/{company ID} in a frame on the page.

The plugin itself sends no data to Refybe. Data is sent to refybe.com by the visitor’s browser when it loads the script or frame, and while the visitor uses the game or loyalty page (for example an email address to receive a login link).

Terms of service: https://refybe.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://refybe.com/privacy
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • The loyalty block now tells where to find the Company ID.

1.0.1

  • Scripts are now loaded with wp_enqueue_script and wp_add_inline_script instead of being printed inline.

1.0.0

  • First release.
